categories.main_business_segments: Imeik Technology Development Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the medical instruments and devices manufacturing industry, focusing on Class III medical devices used in medical aesthetics. The company develops, produces, and sells biomedicine materials and biopharmaceutical products, including skin fillers based on sodium hyaluronate, polylactic acid fillers, and facial implant lines made of poly-p-dioxanone (PPDO). It also engages in research and development of recombinant proteins, peptides, and other biopharmaceutical products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as multi-component composite hydrogel, solid-state gradient interpenetrating crosslinking, water-tight microsphere suspension preparation, tissue fluid bionic technology, and precise water cutting technology. It strictly follows ISO13485 medical device quality management systems and GMP standards for production. The company has established a comprehensive quality management system ensuring 100% product qualification rate and has obtained multiple Class III medical device registrations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Imeik serves medical aesthetic institutions including public hospitals' plastic surgery and dermatology departments, as well as private medical aesthetic clinics. Its products target end consumers seeking non-surgical and surgical aesthetic treatments, such as wrinkle correction and tissue repair. The company also collaborates with medical professionals and institutions through academic activities and digital marketing to enhance product adoption.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with sales covering all 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. Key regional markets include East China, North China, South China, Central China, Southwest China, Northeast China, and Northwest China. It has also begun exploring overseas markets through equity investments and international patent applications, although overseas sales remain minimal.
categories.supply_chain_position: Imeik operates in the midstream segment of the medical aesthetics value chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying medical aesthetic products. Upstream suppliers provide raw materials for medical aesthetic products, while downstream customers are medical aesthetic service providers. The company manages its supply chain comprehensively, including supplier management, procurement, production, warehousing, logistics, and quality traceability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in biomedicine materials and biopharmaceuticals, with ongoing R&D in recombinant proteins, peptides, and advanced medical devices. It invests heavily in R&D (over 10% of revenue) and maintains a strong patent portfolio. Strategic initiatives include expanding product indications, developing new product lines such as second-generation implant lines, and enhancing digital transformation and brand building. Collaboration with academic institutions and medical experts supports technology transfer and clinical research.
categories.revenue_model: Imeik generates revenue primarily through direct sales of its self-developed and manufactured medical aesthetic products, including injectable gels, solutions, and implant lines. The company employs a sales model dominated by direct sales complemented by distributors to reach broader markets. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control of goods to customers, typically at delivery or shipment depending on contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Imeik is a leading domestic player in China's medical aesthetic product manufacturing sector, holding the top market share among Chinese companies in sodium hyaluronate-based skin fillers since 2018. It competes with other domestic and international medical aesthetic product manufacturers, leveraging its strong R&D capabilities, regulatory approvals, and brand recognition. The company has received industry awards recognizing its leadership and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Imeik reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.03 billion, a 5.45% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.96 billion, up 5.33%. Total assets reached RMB 8.34 billion, growing 21.72% from the previous year. The company maintains a strong cash flow from operations and continues to invest significantly in R&D and capital projects, reflecting steady growth and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Imeik emphasizes high-quality, safe, and effective medical aesthetic products with proprietary core technologies and multiple patented innovations. It offers a diversified product portfolio addressing various aesthetic needs with differentiated formulations, including long-lasting fillers and products with added functional ingredients. The company supports customers with comprehensive training, academic engagement, and digital platforms, enhancing brand trust and customer loyalty.
